scenarios.scenario: Combine modification date and file types

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent parts and an assembly modified today are available
no recent-document filters are active
the user opens Filter and chooses Today under Date Modified
the filter control indicates one active filter
the recent list includes the parts and assembly modified today
the user selects Part under File Types
the filter control indicates two active filters
the list displays the parts modified today
the assembly is not displayed
the user also selects Assembly
the filter control indicates three active filters
the list displays the parts and assembly modified today
the user chooses Clear filters
All is selected for Date Modified
the file-type checkboxes are clear
the broader recent list is displayed

scenarios.scenario: Sort recent thumbnail cards by name and reverse the order

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents with different names are shown in Grid View
Sort by is set to Last Opened in descending order
the user opens the Sort by menu
it offers Name, Location, Date Modified, Last Opened, Size and Area
the user chooses Name
the sort field shows Name
the visible cards are ordered by name in descending order
the user activates the sort direction control
the visible cards are ordered by name in ascending order

scenarios.scenario: Inspect actions for one recent document

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are shown in List View
no recent-document checkboxes are selected
the user opens the actions menu on a recent part row
the menu offers Open and opens with options
the menu offers Remove from Recent
the menu offers commands to open or explore the containing folder
the menu offers document properties

scenarios.scenario: Inspect actions while a recent document is checked

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are shown in List View
a recent-document checkbox is selected
the user opens a recent row's actions menu
